intent.objective: Apply the option-1 planning delta that preserves the current DomainSpec Key-and-Door fixture generation, selects one fresh A1 rebind, and gates A2 through A4 sequentially.
intent.operator_sentence: Apply the already approved current-fixture rebind refresh without executing target SWUs.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The approved Refresh is one sequential bookkeeping mutation with shared target files.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Parallel writers would overlap the same planning and Craft projections; local sequential apply is the safe shape.
context: No independent research or sibling implementation work is part of Refresh.

boundaries.contract: Option 1 authorizes preservation of the current A1 input generation and the exact A1-to-A3 planning route, not target execution or fixture mutation.

boundaries.from_owner: A4 replay and DomainSpec fixture owners
boundaries.contract: Read-only fixture and replay evidence may change selection and dependencies but cannot become implementation or authority evidence.
Refresh selects only A1. Task Session must use a strict context pack, recheck all three hashes immediately before mutation, and stop after a fresh A1 receipt.

authority.lifecycle: invoke refresh owns planning synchronization only
authority.execution: task-session owns the later bounded A1 rebind
authority.validation: context-builder, dispatch-spec, JSON/YAML parsing, hash checks, Craft parity, and diff hygiene
authority.evidence: A4 replay receipt, decision receipt, actual A1 binding paths, and live Key-and-Door bytes
authority.promotion: DomainSpec, CAV2 authority, promotion, and publication owners remain separate

state_namespaces.owner: A4 replay and DomainSpec fixture owners

state_namespaces.write_policy: ledger plus synchronized machine and human projections

promotion_splits.source: fixture decision, Refresh receipt, and later A1-A4 receipts
promotion_splits.rule: The six-value ineligibility fence is unchanged.

steps.name: Select strict decision, fixture, historical, and target context

inputs.ref: option-1 decision plus live A1 fixture drift

stop_conditions: block if the actual A1 allowlisted paths are unresolved
block if any obligation or mutation boundary is uncovered

steps.name: Resolve the owning project and target inventory
stop_conditions: block if index.json is absent or unparsable
block if Inventory is treated as authority

steps.name: Apply the exact current-fixture planning and Craft delta
stop_conditions: block if more than A1 is selected
block if historical receipts are rewritten
block if DomainSpec or IOLM implementation changes
block if Craft projections diverge from the ledger
block if the six-value fence changes

steps.name: Validate applied state and return the A1 owner route
stop_conditions: block on Dispatch Spec, JSON, YAML, hash, selection, Craft parity, or diff failure
block if the fixture snapshot drifts before Refresh validation
block if the returned route selects A2, A3, or A4

gates.condition: All ten obligations are covered by no more than fourteen selector-bound sources.
The exact invoke:refresh:apply-approved route is authorized by option 1 and the direct operator invocation.
Only the A1 rebind is selected; A2 regeneration, A3 revalidation, and A4 replay are gated.
No fixture, implementation, historical evidence, authority, public Arcanum, promotion, or publication surface changes.
Dispatch, syntax, fixture stability, planning synchronization, Craft parity, and diff hygiene pass.

promotion_guardrails: No Refresh or fixture receipt promotes candidate knowledge or changes authority.
No workable-example receipt can satisfy 00C-B, 00C-C, G-DSV2-SG, CROSS_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED, promotion, or publication.
